items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Joe Thomas and Ed Wilcox, the pianist. The two of them were – became co-leaders of the band... Then I left them

ctx.x: Joe Thomas and Earl Carruthers – no, Joe Thomas and Ed Wilcox, the pianist. The two of them were – became co-leaders of the band. It didn’t last very long. Then I left them and went with – I think that was when I – I came back, and I went back to Philly again.
Is that when you – here I’ve got Lucky Millinder, or maybe it was Sam Donahue?
